title: See local images
summary: An image list shows packages stored on your machine. A tag is a readable label for an image version.
introduction: An image list shows packages stored on your machine. A tag is a readable label for an image version. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An image list shows packages stored on your machine. A tag is a readable label for an image version.
The table shows local image names, tags and sizes. The list depends on what has been downloaded or built.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find the hello-world image after the previous lesson.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A mutable tag can later point to another image; it is not a permanent content identity.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).

seo.title: Docker: See local images
seo.description: Learn about see local images in Docker. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
